evidence.excerpt: Recipient Name: MARATHON FUSION, INC.; Award Amount: 3630998.0; Start Date: 2026-03-06; Awarding Agency: Department of Energy; Awarding Sub Agency: Department of Energy; Description: MARATHON FUSION: NEW AWARD VISION OPEN 2024, CONTROL# 3387-2677 PROJECT TITLE: PARTIAL IONIZATION CENTRIFUGE ENABLING DIFFERENTIAL PUMPING AND LITHIUM ISOTOPE SEPARATION FOR FUSION ENERGY THIS COMPETITIVE COOPERATIVE AGREEMENT FOR A RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT PROJECT ENTITLED, “PARTIAL IONIZATION CENTRIFUGE ENABLING DIFFERENTIAL PUMPING AND LITHIUM ISOTOPE SEPARATION FOR FUSION ENERGY” IS AWARDED MARATHON FUSION UNDER ARPA-E FOA NUMBER DE-FOA-0003387 (VISION OPEN 2024) AND CONTROL 3387-2677. THE PURPOSE OF THIS AWARD IS PURSUE A NOVEL APPROACH TO THE PARTIAL IONIZATION CENTRIFUGE, ENABLING LARGE SEPARATION FACTORS AND THROUGHPUTS SPECIFICALLY FOR LIGHT ISOTOPES RELEVANT TO FUSION APPLICATIONS. THIS TECHNOLOGY HAS TWO IMPORTANT IMPLICATIONS FOR THE DEPLOYABILITY AND ECONOMIC VIABILITY OF FUSION ENERGY. FIRST, AS A DIFFERENTIAL FUEL PUMPING SYSTEM CAPABLE OF ACCESSING HIGH (~20%) TRITIUM BURN EFFICIENCY OPERATION IN A FUSION DEVICE AT HIGH (>90%) FUSION POWER DENSITY FRACTION. SECOND, BY ENABLING LITHIUM I
